description: This PHP abstract class defines a generic mechanism for processing matchers within the Goteo project, handling investments, user pools, and payment methods, along with utility functions for identifying, creating, and describing matcher processors.

classes.name: AbstractMatcherProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class that provides core functionalities for processing matchers, managing investments, projects, user pools, and payment methods, as well as utility methods for identification, creation, and event listener configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the processor with a Matcher object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns a simplified, lowercase identifier for the processor class.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for the processor class.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Returns a description of the processor; default is empty.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if the provided Matcher corresponds to this processor.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the processor for a given Matcher if valid.

methods.name: getVarLabels
methods.description: Returns variable labels for the processor; default is empty array.

methods.name: getVars
methods.description: Retrieves the default and custom variables associated with the matcher.

methods.name: getUserAmounts
methods.description: Calculates how to distribute a total amount among users based on their pools.

methods.name: getInvests
methods.description: Generates a list of Invest objects based on the matcher, project, and available amount.

methods.name: setMatcher
methods.description: Associates a Matcher object with this processor.

methods.name: getMatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the current Matcher object.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a Project object with this processor.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves the Project object, throws exception if not set.

methods.name: setInvest
methods.description: Associates an Invest object with this processor.

methods.name: getInvest
methods.description: Retrieves the current Invest object.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Associates a PaymentMethodInterface object as the payment method.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the payment method object.

methods.name: getAppEventListeners
methods.description: Returns default application event listeners for this processor.

methods.name: getConsoleEventListeners
methods.description: Returns default console event listeners for this processor.
